rules.event: landlord serves notice of rent review on tenant
rules.source: RTB — Important changes to rental law from 14 September 2026
rules.guardrail: Do not calculate the deadline until the actual service date is established.

rules: Do not assume the trigger date.
Do not substitute publication date for effective date.
Preserve historical rules when the trigger predates a legal change.
If service timing is disputed, return REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than inventing a date.

scope_limit: This is the first verified deadline seed, not a complete deadline corpus for Irish tenancy law.
